title: Flat Door
body:
"A door that can be filled with any material. Can be opened and closed."


The Flat Door is a schematic that can be purchased from Illumine Designs for $375. It creates a flat door.

Description

The Flat Door is a door with no door handle or any special paneling. Once the Flat Door's schematic is filled, anyone with property edit permissions can change the direction the door swings in, or open/close the door. Much like any other door, any player can choose to knock on the door.

Laying the Flat Door on its side allows the builder to create trapdoors/hatches.
